rv.q: Both men were fairly similar to each other in style and tone and I would have liked to have seen a woman take on some of the roles. A larger discussion perhaps needs to be had about men playing great female characters in dresses with wigs and silly voices for laughs, but that’s for another day.

A personal favourite is the ‘Mary’ song, in which both men dress up in fantastic gowns (designed by Jacqueline Trousdale), one as Mary Tudor and the other as Mary Queen of Scots, highlighting their similarities and differences through musical banter.
